description: This source file is a CMake script that manages the configuration and build process for the AOTriton library, including dependency management, versioning, downloading pre-built binaries, and handling platform-specific build steps.

methods.name: aotriton_build_windows_dependencies
methods.description: Builds Windows-specific dependencies required by AOTriton such as dlfcn-win32 and xz/liblzma.

methods.name: aotriton_build_from_source
methods.description: Builds the AOTriton library from source, handling submodules and platform-specific adjustments.

methods.name: aotriton_download_runtime
methods.description: Downloads pre-compiled AOTriton runtime binaries for specified ROCm and Linux configurations.

methods.name: aotriton_download_image
methods.description: Downloads prebuilt GPU image tarballs for specific images and extracts them appropriately.
